briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI push frontier scaling as DialectForge secures multi-agent protocols

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models this month. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny mount while safety vulnerabilities persist across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with enhanced reasoning; xAI releases Grok-3; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 2.5 Pro. Meta open-sources Llama 4.1 while DeepSeek-R2 challenges cost leadership.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize agentic isolation.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Microsoft announces $15B Texas supercluster; Oracle and CoreWeave expand GPU fleets amid power shortages.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dialect negotiation become mandatory infrastructure before the first AGI deployment?
